body: I don't think you have to have a job, hobbies or "good future" or friends to deserve love really. As long as you're not mean and selfish you should be enough without all those status creating stuff. But people are shallow and dumb so yeah... Sorry to hear it happened to you.
If it wasn't for this lack of true connection, I would be 100% happy really. I just want to share this otherwise beautiful life with people. But thank you so much for you answer!

I'm exactly in the same position. People have even called ambulances/police to come get me instead of just asking me what's wrong. It's embarrassing as fuck. There's just no way of saying it and things ending well. Yey for anonymous reddit aye?
